description: Assess only the supplied CV against atomic job requirements using Jev evidence probabilities. Returns one source score, assessmentKind=source_only, method=jev-probability-v1 and per-requirement met/not_met/unknown probabilities, confidence and actual model version. Every requirement stays in the denominator; the score is 100 times mean probabilityMet. No tailored CV or after score is generated. Run tailor_cv for actual document before/after assessment.

cvText.description: The full CV/resume as plain text.

name: score_cv
